full_prompt_en: A square watercolor editorial cartoon gathers a group of curious city dwellers beneath a strange green creature leaning in from the upper left. At the center front stands a disheveled man in a blue suit and pale tie, his long nose, spiky brown hair, and wide round eyes showing startled uncertainty. To his left, a gray haired man in a pale shirt and a woman in yellow peer upward. To his right, a blond woman with a small smile and a younger brunette in a necklace stand close together, while two taller men lean over their shoulders from the back. Above them, the green creature has a long snout, protruding eyes, a dark open mouth, and small uneven teeth. Its neck rises from a patch of leafy green at the far left, making it seem to enter the city scene unexpectedly. Loose pale gray outlines of tall buildings appear behind the group under a light blue sky. More green leaves frame the right edge, and the lower part of the image fades to open white paper around the figures' shoulders. The people are tightly packed, their varied expressions and exaggerated facial proportions forming a lively rhythm. Fine brown and black ink lines describe hair, eyebrows, noses, collars, and the creature's teeth; translucent washes of slate blue, ocher, pale peach, and green keep the drawing light. Bright diffuse daylight gives the scene little shadow. The result is friendly and absurd, with the visual joke carried by a green intrusion into an otherwise ordinary crowd.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形水彩编辑漫画把一群好奇的城市居民聚在一只从左上探入的奇异绿色生物下方。最前中央，一名穿蓝西装、浅色领带的男子头发蓬乱，长鼻、棕色竖发和睁圆的眼睛显出惊讶不定。他左边，灰发浅衬衫男子与黄衣女子抬头张望。右边，面带小小微笑的金发女子和戴项链的年轻棕发女子紧靠一起，后面两名更高男子越过她们肩膀探头。上方绿生物有长口鼻、突眼、深色张口和参差小牙。它的颈部从最左的一片绿叶中升起，像突然闯入城市场景。人群背后，浅灰色高楼线条松散地立在浅蓝天空下。更多绿叶框住右缘，画面下方围着众人肩膀渐淡成开放纸白。人物挤在一起，多样表情和夸张面部比例形成活跃节奏。细棕黑墨线描写头发、眉毛、鼻子、衣领和生物牙齿；石板蓝、赭黄、浅桃和绿色透明洗色让绘画轻盈。明亮漫射日光让场景少有阴影。画面友好而荒诞，视觉笑点来自绿色闯入寻常人群。
style_prompt_en: Watercolor editorial cartooning combines quick elastic ink line with pale transparent color and generous exposed paper. Several compact upright shapes overlap closely, each differentiated by a few exaggerated contours, while a contrasting irregular shape interrupts the cluster from one side. Fine wobbly lines carry expression and texture; washes of slate blue, green, ocher, peach, and warm gray remain light and uneven. Background geometry is only sketched, dissolving into a bright almost white field. The lower edge fades without a hard boundary, giving the dense central grouping air. Broad daylight is even, and shadows stay shallow so line and silhouette do the main work. The design feels playful, observant, and gently absurd, with many small individual variations held within one clear graphic arrangement.
style_prompt_zh: 水彩编辑漫画把迅捷有弹性的墨线、浅透明颜色与大面积露纸结合。几道紧凑竖形紧密重叠，靠少量夸张轮廓区分；一块不同的不规则形体从一侧打断形体群。细而微摇的线条承载表情与肌理，石板蓝、绿、赭黄、桃色和暖灰洗色保持浅薄且不均。背景几何只是速写，溶入近乎白色的明亮区域。下缘不设硬边而渐淡，让密集中央群体仍可呼吸。宽广日光均匀，阴影很浅，使线条与剪影承担主要表达。设计活泼、观察细致且温和荒诞，许多个体小变化被一个清楚图形安排收住。
theme_en: A group of curious city dwellers surprised by a small green creature
theme_zh: 一群城市居民惊讶地看着一只绿色小生物
name: Cathy Wilcox
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
